actions.action: Bind callouts to explicit evidence checks
actions.mechanism: Reevaluate analyst-defined descriptive claims against stable metric IDs, filter IDs, and recorded date ranges after refresh.
actions.implementation: Store a claim predicate, evidence values, resolved dates, and analyst-set materiality tolerance. Flag failed predicates or changed date scope for review.
actions.check: Ranking reversal and date-range change trigger review; a revision within tolerance preserves validity when the predicate still holds.
actions.risk: Poorly chosen tolerances can conceal meaningful changes.

actions.action: Represent missing evidence separately from zero
actions.mechanism: Typed evidence states prevent absent series and null observations from being interpreted as measured zero.
actions.implementation: Distinguish absent series, missing observations, and numeric values during evaluation. Mark unsupported callouts unverifiable; display gaps rather than inserting zeros.
actions.check: Remove a referenced series, null one observation, and supply a genuine zero; verify three distinct states and appropriate callout warnings.
actions.risk: Existing aggregations may silently coerce missing values.

actions.action: Gate exports on version-specific evidence review
actions.mechanism: An atomic export snapshot prevents refreshed data from bypassing annotation checks or mixing versions.
actions.implementation: Freeze chart data and annotations together; block export until flagged callouts are edited, removed, or explicitly qualified. Embed version, IDs, dates, and review decisions.
actions.check: Refresh during export: output must use one identifiable version, with no unreviewed changed-evidence callouts.
actions.risk: Some export formats require a bundled metadata manifest.

actions.action: Bound and consolidate refresh review work
actions.mechanism: A per-annotation review queue consolidates repeated changes while retaining an audit trail and explicit unresolved status.
actions.implementation: Keep one pending review per annotation, update its latest evidence, and retain versioned changes. At capacity, pause review intake and mark unchecked versions export-ineligible.
actions.check: Replay a refresh burst containing reversal then recovery; retain both events without duplicate review items. Overflow must never silently clear warnings.
actions.risk: Consolidation can hide transient changes without visible history.
